title: ATP Assay for Measuring Luminescence Levels
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v7ke9kw

steps.title: Seed cells in 96-well plates
steps.instruction: Seed cells into 96-well plates and allow them to grow for the indicated time periods before proceeding with the assay.

steps.title: Add CellTiter-Glo reagent
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL CellTiter‑Glo reagent directly to each well, incubate the plate for 10 min, then measure luminescence with an EnSpire® Multimode Plate Reader (PerkinElmer, Waltham, MA, USA).

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL CellTiter‑Glo reagent to each well
Read luminescence using EnSpire® Multimode Plate Reader (PerkinElmer, Waltham, MA, USA)

steps.title: Calculate ATP content
steps.instruction: Calculate ATP content by comparing each sample’s luminescence to control wells defined as 100 %; perform assays in triplicate and repeat the experiment at least twice.
